description: Find a PC game by title and get its id. Call this FIRST when the user names a game but you do not have its Steam AppID or igdb id, then pass the id to get_cheapest_way_to_play, get_offers or is_on_subscription. Returns up to 20 matches (id, title, slug).

query.description: Game title or part of it, 2-100 characters.

name: search_games
